model: MOVITRAC LTP-B standard inverter (built-in Modbus RTU)
applies_to: SEW-EURODRIVE MOVITRAC LTP-B inverters on the RJ45 Modbus RTU port (no communication or encoder option card fitted), per product manual 31554814/EN edition 10/2023.
summary: SEW-EURODRIVE's standard inverter with Modbus RTU on the RJ45 communication socket. Registers 1-4 carry the process output words and 6-9 the process input words; words 2-4 and 7-9 are freely assignable in parameter group P5. Other parameters sit at register = parameter number (101 = P1-01), except the P0 monitoring group, which has its own register numbers.

addressing.note: The manual's register numbers start at 1 and it warns that zero-based masters must subtract 1. Its frame example reads registers 107/108 (P1-07/P1-08) with start address 0x006A = 106. Parameters use register = parameter number (P5-03 = 503 = wire address 502).

source.title: Product Manual - Standard Inverters MOVITRAC LTP-B
source.pages: 11.1.2 P0 monitoring table pp. 136-137; 11.1.3 parameter register table pp. 142-144; P1-12 p. 150; P5-01 to P5-14 pp. 176-179; 13.1.1 process data words pp. 211-212; 13.1.3 settings p. 213; 13.3 Modbus RTU pp. 217-218

notes: Registers 2-4 and 7-9 change meaning with P5-09 to P5-14; the scaling given is for the factory assignment. Each option's scaling is listed in the P5-09 to P5-14 value lists.
Speed values are relative (16384 = 100 % of P1-01) and are kept raw.

Left out: P0 monitor registers whose layout in the manual's table could not be read unambiguously (speed setpoint 22, torque 41, DC link 23, heat sink 24, kWh/MWh counters 30-33); P5-06 communication timeout (register scaling not stated); most P1-P4 parameters because the Modbus scaling of each is not given.
The manual's example reads P1-08 (register 108) as 0x2B = 43, a percentage of the inverter current, so P1-08 is not in amperes; it is left out.
Function code 16 (write multiple) works for the PO words; 03 and 06 work on all registers.
Modbus is not available once a communication option or an encoder card is fitted in the option slot.

integration.summary: Set P1-14 = 201, P1-12 = 7 and P1-15 per the manual, then write register 1 = 0x0006 with register 2 = speed (16384 = P1-01). Poll registers 6-9 for status, speed, current and power.
integration.enable: Set P1-14 = 201 (extended menu), P1-12 = 7 (Modbus RTU or fieldbus) and P1-15 as given in the manual's fieldbus table. P5-01 sets the address (factory 1), P5-03 the baud rate (factory 115200) and P5-04 the format (factory no parity, 1 stop bit). The enable inputs must still be wired.
integration.watchdog: P5-06 sets the communication-failure time (0.0-5.0 s, factory 1.0 s; 0.0 keeps running). P5-05 sets the reaction: 0 fault and coast, 1 stop ramp and fault, 2 stop ramp without fault (factory), 3 run at fixed setpoint speed 8.
quirks: Register numbers are 1-based: subtract 1 for the wire address.
Control word bit 0 = 1 inhibits the output stage; 0x0006 runs, 0x0000 is a rapid stop.
Process words 2-4 and 7-9 are reassignable: always check P5-09 to P5-14 before trusting a scale.
setup: Wire RS485- (Modbus) to RJ45 pin 7 and RS485+ to pin 8.
Up to 32 nodes; 1200 m at 115200 bit/s with 0.5 mm2 cable.
gotchas: Fitting a fieldbus or encoder option card disables Modbus on the RJ45 port.
The P0 monitoring group does not follow the register = parameter number rule.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
